description: This Java test class contains integration tests for the SmsApiResource, specifically testing the retrieval of SMS messages by campaign and status. It sets up mock server responses, creates campaigns, sends test SMS messages, and verifies the API's behavior under various conditions.

classes.name: SmsApiResourceIntegrationTest
classes.description: Integration test class for the SmsApiResource API, focusing on SMS message retrieval by campaign and status, utilizing mock server responses and various test scenarios.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST API settings, request and response specifications, and campaign helper before each test.

methods.name: testRetrieveAllSmsByStatus_validStatus
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of SMS messages filtering by a valid status, verifying message content and status filtering.

methods.name: testRetrieveAllSmsByStatus_invalidStatus
methods.description: Tests the API's response when querying SMS messages with an invalid status, expecting an empty or default response.
